note: The three surfaces that draw `ProxyTag`, which must draw the SAME one: the decklist row, the commander caption on the deck head, and the review row. Its own inventory rather than a section of `proxies.json`, because `check:shared` asks the `shares` block of every row in its file — and that file also photographs the list route and the `/decks` tile, neither of which draws a mark. The deck head is a separate row from the decklist even though one `goto` reaches both: the caption is in a `<header>` outside `<main>`, and a shot scrolled to the rows does not show it. `spine-mobile.tsx` gets its OWN row: `check:shared` reads each row's `view` directly, so with the desktop spine alone a phone-only regression would leave the gate green while the mobile caption stopped using the shared mark — the same reason `commander-image.json` carries both spines. And the review row needs `PROXY_REVIEW_DECK`: a versioned deck whose DRAFT holds a printed add, because `admitsReview` redirects a deck with no pending changes and the cell would photograph a redirect. CORRECTED 2026-09-15 — this paragraph said `deck-card-tile.tsx` was a fifth renderer of the mark that this file does not check, because reaching the card view needed a click on a toggle that "resolves then times out". MEASURED: it does not time out. `card-captions.json` presses the same toggle by the same accessible name and reached all four of its cells, and `probe:card-captions` clicks it too. What actually defeats a run on these routes is the About gate (#658), which redirects a reader below `ABOUT_VERSION` and lets the cell count as reached while photographing the About page — see that file's note. A card-view row for the mark is therefore BUILDABLE here and is left unbuilt rather than blocked; the tile's use of the shared mark is still held by `deck-card-tile.test.tsx`, which renders a proxied card and asserts the mark rather than a local copy.

shares.note: Each view renders it as-is — no wrapper between them — so the check is asked of the file each row already names.

/decks/[id]/changes — a PENDING printed add, marked not billed
/decks/[id] — the mark on a commander caption
/decks/[id] — the commander caption's mark, phone spine
